# Rana Bakery, Manali

> A family-run bakery and cake shop in Bahang, Manali (Himachal Pradesh, India) since 1992. Everything is baked fresh every morning in small batches. Known for fresh cream cakes, brownies and aloo patties, plus pastries, donuts and coconut macaroons. Delivers within about 10 km of Manali, delivered by the bakery's own team, 9 am to 8 pm. The bakery replies on WhatsApp with one price for the order and a delivery time. Also supplies hotels, cafes and restaurants (HORECA) in the Manali area.

## Key facts
- Address: Rohtang Road, opposite GSS School, Bahang, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175103, India (on the highway from Manali towards Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel and Rohtang)
- Established: 1992, family-run
- Hours: open daily, 8 am to 9 pm
- Phone / WhatsApp orders: +91 83508 90419
- Price: about ₹200 to ₹400 per person

## Menu highlights
- Fresh cream cakes: Black Forest, Pineapple, Strawberry, Butterscotch, Chocolate, Chocolate Truffle (all cakes are 100% eggless, made to order, custom cakes a day ahead)
- Brownies (bestseller, dense and fudgy, baked fresh daily)
- Aloo patties (savoury bestseller)
- Fresh cream pastries
- Donuts
- Coconut macaroons
- From the counter: cream rolls, jeera biscuits, chocolate balls, fresh pizza, buns, aata (whole wheat) bread, coffee

## Menu prices
- Eggless cakes (Black Forest, Pineapple, Strawberry, Butterscotch, Chocolate): Small (about 500 g) ₹569, Medium (about 850 g) ₹1,099
- Chocolate Truffle cake: price on request
- Eggless walnut brownie: ₹129 each
- Veg patty: ₹60 each. Combo of 2 patties + 2 Coca-Cola (250 ml): ₹180
- Pastries: from ₹75 a piece (Black Forest, Butterscotch ₹75; Pineapple, Strawberry ₹79), made with egg or eggless
- Chocolate donut: ₹60 each
- Coconut macaroons: ₹15 each, pack of 10 ₹150
- Direct orders on WhatsApp get up to 30% off these menu prices.

## Delivery
- Rana Bakery delivers within about 10 km of Manali, delivered by the bakery's own team.
- Delivery hours: 9 am to 8 pm (shop hours are 8 am to 9 pm).
- Order by WhatsApp or phone on +91 83508 90419. Also listed on Zomato.
- Minimum order for delivery: ₹400. No minimum at the bakery counter.
- The bakery replies on WhatsApp with one price for the order and a delivery time.
- WhatsApp delivery order: https://wa.me/918350890419?text=Namaste!%20Delivery%20order%20karna%20hai
- Zomato: https://www.zomato.com/manali/rana-bakery-1-tibetan-colony

## Common questions
- Does Rana Bakery deliver in Manali? Yes, the bakery delivers itself within about 10 km of Manali, from 9 am to 8 pm. Send your order and location on WhatsApp (+91 83508 90419) and the bakery replies with one price for the order and a delivery time. Also on Zomato.
- How far does Rana Bakery deliver? Within about 10 km of Manali. If unsure, send your location on WhatsApp and the bakery will confirm.
- Is there a minimum order for delivery? Yes, ₹400.
- How much is a birthday cake? Eggless Black Forest, Pineapple, Strawberry, Butterscotch and Chocolate cakes are ₹569 small (about 500 g) and ₹1,099 medium (about 850 g). Up to 30% off when ordered direct on WhatsApp.
- How much are brownies and patties? Eggless walnut brownie ₹129, veg patty ₹60, combo of 2 patties + 2 Coca-Cola (250 ml) ₹180. Up to 30% off when ordered direct on WhatsApp.
- Where is Rana Bakery? Rohtang Road, opposite GSS School, Bahang, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175103.
- What time is it open? Every day from 8 am to 9 pm.
- Do you make eggless cakes? Yes, all cakes are eggless. Pastries are made with egg or eggless on request.
- How do I order a birthday or custom cake? Message on WhatsApp a day ahead with your theme and size. All cakes are eggless.
- What is Rana Bakery known for? Fresh cream cakes, fudgy brownies and hot aloo patties, plus fresh cream pastries, donuts and coconut macaroons.
- How much does it cost? About ₹200 to ₹400 per person.
- Do you supply hotels and cafes? Yes, hotels, restaurants and cafes around Manali. Message on WhatsApp for bulk rates.
- Does Rana Bakery have rooms or a hotel? No. It is a bakery and cake shop only and does not rent rooms.
